200L Brine Tank for Water Softeners - Salt & Brine Storage

The 200L brine tank from Puritech offers large capacity storage for salt and brine solution in water softener systems. It helps ensure smooth regeneration cycles, improves the efficiency of your softener, and reduces the need for frequent salt refills. Furthermore, this tank is built to last, with durable materials and a robust design that suits both residential and commercial use.

Whether you are installing a new system or upgrading an existing one, this brine tank provides the space and reliability needed to support consistent water softener performance.

Why You Need a Brine Tank

A brine tank stores the salt pellets or crystals needed to create a concentrated brine solution. During the regeneration phase of a water softener, this salt solution is drawn into the softener's resin tank to recharge it. Therefore, having a properly sized brine reservoir - like this 200L brine tank - helps maintain efficient softener cycles and avoids hard water issues like scaling.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Large 200 L Capacity

    • This tank holds up to 200 liters of salt and brine, which means fewer refills and longer intervals between maintenance.

  • Easy to Fill and Maintain

    • With a straightforward design, the tank makes it easy to add salt and inspect brine levels, even when space is limited.

  • Durable Construction

    • Built from tough, corrosion-resistant plastic, the brine tank resists wear from salt and brine exposure, giving you long-lasting service.

  • Optimised for Water Softeners

    • It integrates smoothly with most residential and light commercial softener systems, helping ensure reliable regeneration.

  • Simple Installation

    • The tank's form and connections make set-up quick and easy, whether you are replacing an old tank or installing this with a new softener.

Technical Specifications

Specification Details
Product Name 200L Brine Tank
Capacity 200 litres
Material High-quality salt-resistant plastic
Use Brine storage for water softener systems
Operating Temp. 5 �C - 45 �C
Design Vertical, space-saving build
Recommended For Residential & light commercial softeners

How It Works

When your water softener enters a regeneration cycle, it draws the concentrated brine solution from this 200L brine tank and uses it to clean the resin beads inside the softener. This process restores the softening capacity so that your system continues to remove hardness minerals effectively.

After brine draw, the tank refills with water to make fresh brine. Thanks to the larger capacity, this 200 L tank needs fewer top-ups and delivers consistent performance over time.

Where to Use This Brine Tank

  • Homes with higher water usage needing more frequent regeneration
  • Commercial environments like offices, small hotels, or laundromats
  • Larger softener systems that require substantial brine reserves
  • Systems where longer service intervals are important

Installation & Maintenance Tips

  1. Position the tank on a flat surface near your softener valve.
  2. Fill with recommended salt type (pellets or crystals) before initial use.
  3. Check brine levels regularly and refill as needed.
  4. Clean the tank periodically to avoid build-up of debris or sludge.

With proper care, this tank will continue helping your softener operate smoothly and efficiently.

Conclusion

The Puritech 200L brine tank offers a generous, robust solution for brine storage in water softener systems. Because it holds a larger volume of salt and brine solution, it reduces the need for frequent refills, supports dependable regeneration, and fits well in both residential and light commercial settings. Additionally, its durable build and easy installation make it a smart choice when expanding or upgrading your softening system.

3/4?inch PVDF Venturi Injector - Ozone Disinfection Injector

The 3/4?inch PVDF Venturi Injector is built specifically for injecting ozone into flowing water streams for disinfection and purification. It uses the Venturi effect, where water passing through a constricted section creates suction that draws ozone gas into the flow. Made of high-grade PVDF (polyvinylidene fluoride), this injector withstands continuous ozone exposure and resists corrosion.

Features & Specifications

  • Size / Connection: 3/4? inlet/outlet compatibility, suitable for standard, larger pipe networks.

  • Corrosion & UV Resistance: Suitable for aggressive environments involving oxidising gases and high-performance water treatment.

Benefits of a PVDF Venturi Injector for Ozone

  • Efficient ozone mixing: Because the injector uses water flow to draw ozone, you save on external pumps and simplify system design.
  • Long service life & minimal maintenance: PVDF is highly resistant, so the unit keeps working under tough conditions.
  • Better water hygiene: With reliable ozone injection, you get strong disinfection and fewer chemical residues.
  • Versatile sizing: A 3/4? diameter makes the unit suitable for mid-size commercial or high-demand systems.

Installation & Usage Tips

  1. Ensure correct flow direction-water enters the main port, ozone is introduced via the side suction port.

  6. For optimum results, match flow speed and injector sizing according to supplier tables for your ozone generator and pipe size.

Triple-Stage Countertop Water Filter for Cleaner Kitchen Tap Water

Cleaner Kitchen Tap Water Made Simple

A countertop water filter offers an easy way to improve everyday tap water without complex installation. This triple-stage filtration system connects directly to your kitchen tap and helps reduce sediment, chlorine taste, and unpleasant odors. As a result, water becomes clearer and more enjoyable for drinking and cooking.

How Triple-Stage Filtration Improves Water

This kitchen tap filter uses a three-step filtration process to treat water as it flows through the unit. First, a sediment layer traps sand, rust, and visible particles. Next, activated carbon reduces chlorine taste and smell. Finally, a polishing stage improves clarity before water reaches your glass. Because the system relies on normal tap pressure, it works without electricity.

Compact Countertop Filter Design

Designed to sit neatly next to your sink, this water filter fits most kitchen spaces. At the same time, the compact housing keeps your counter uncluttered. In addition, installation is quick and tool-free, making it suitable for both permanent homes and rental properties.

Key Features

  • Three-stage filtration for better taste and clarity
  • Direct tap connection with diverter valve
  • No electricity or drilling required
  • Compact countertop design
  • Easy cartridge replacement

Benefits for Daily Use

Using a countertop filtration system helps reduce bottled water use, which saves money and cuts plastic waste. Moreover, better-tasting water often encourages healthier hydration habits. This filtered tap water is also ideal for tea, coffee, cooking, and cold drinks.

Where This Filter Works Best

This kitchen tap water filter is suitable for:

  • Home kitchens
  • Flats and rental units
  • Office kitchens
  • Temporary or portable water filtration needs

Simple Maintenance and Reliable Performance

To keep the system performing well, filter cartridges should be replaced as recommended based on water quality and usage. With basic care, this countertop filter provides consistent water improvement day after day.

 

** Please note that the water filter will work perfectly with water that is safe for human consumption. Should you wish to filter borehole water, you will be required to get the water analyzed by a lab and send us the report so we can recommend a solution for your water.
